name: notion-meeting-intelligence
title_zh: 开会前自动翻遍 Notion 并备好两份材料的会议秘
tagline_zh: 会前 10 分钟还在翻资料？它替你从 Notion 聚合上下文，Claude 补研究，生成内部预读与对外议程。
tagline_en: Stop scrambling before calls. It pulls context from Notion, enriches with Claude research, and saves an internal.
desc_en: Prepares meeting materials by gathering context from Notion, enriching with Claude research, and creating both an internal pre-read and external agenda saved to Notion. Helps you arrive prepared with comprehensive background and structured meeting docs.
why_zh: 不是简单列议程，而是先建「内部预读 + 外部议程」的双轨结构，让参会者带着同一套背景知识进场。
why_en: It builds a dual-track doc structure — internal pre-read and external agenda — so everyone shares the same background and.
limit_zh: 只认 Notion 工作区里已有的页面，不会主动建库或抓取外部链接；产出是两份 Markdown 文档，不含投票。
limit_en: Only works with pages already in your Notion workspace; no auto-creation or external crawling. Outputs two Markdown docs only — no voting, task.
title_en: Notion meeting prep: gather context, research, and save.
